issue_context.title: [BUG] Testing react components. Strange reaction
issue_context.body: ### System info - Playwright Version: `"@playwright/experimental-ct-react" - 1.33.0` - Operating System: macOS 13.3.1 ventura ### Source code - [ ] I provided exact source code that allows reproducing the issue locally. **Button.spec.tsx** Failed case ```ts import { test, expect } from '@playwright/experimental-ct-react'; import Button from './Button.component'; test('render the base button', async ({ mount }) => { const component = await mount(); await expect(component).toHaveScreenshot(); }); test.use({ viewport: { width: 1000, height: 900 } }); test('render the full width button', async ({ mount }) => { const component = await mount(); await expect(component).toHaveScreenshot(); }); // test('test text', async ({ mount }) => { // const component = await mount(click me); // await expect(component).toContainText('click me'); // }); ``` **Button.spec.tsx** Success case ```ts import { test, expect } from '@playwright/experimental-ct-react'; import Button from './Button.component'; test('render the base button', async ({ mount }) => { const component = await mount(); await expect(component).toHaveScreenshot(); }); test.use({ viewport: { width: 1000, height: 900 } }); test('render the full width button', async ({ mount }) => { const component = await mount(); await expect(component).toHaveScreenshot(); }); ``` **Steps** - write the test - add commented test below **Expected** the comment does not affect the work **Actual** ```bash Error: Cannot find module '/Users/mikeglyc/job/wallet/ui-kit/src/components/Button/Button.component' imported from /Users/mikeglyc/job/wallet/ui-kit/src/components/Button/Button.spec.tsx ```
comments: test breaks on any change. The only suspicion is that may be is saved by the local cache playwright? I tried to completely remove it from the project and put. Only previously written tests work and without a single change

>I'm also pretty sure that this is only happening after upgrading from version 1.31.2 => 1.32.0. The diff between those versions is quite large, I was trying to see what might be causing it.

I'm seeing

```Error: Cannot find module '/name.pw-test-components' imported from name.pw-test.tsx```

only in 1.33, not 1.31 or 1.32.
@peterkrieg, thx. It's helped me, but problem in 1.33 exists

We'll get this fixed in 1.34.

The problem is that VS Code extension is running `npx playwright test --list` which does not account for the component testing plugins.

As a workaround, locate your temporary folder:

```sh
find /var/folders | grep playwright-transform
```

and delete all the folders that have `playwright-transform-cache` in the name.
@pavelfeldman thank you. It helped me, but i stay on version 1.32, she is more stable
